Hello! My name's Charlie Kopp. I am a proud nerd with a passion for mental health advocacy and highlighting the unique connections that bring humans together in mind and spirit.

I am currently studying Statistics and Data Science at UCLA, but what makes me special is my personal journey through sobriety and recovery, and experience with interpersonal communication and leadership.

I have battled through addiction and mental health crises, granting me a newfound appreciation for life after becoming sober at 19. Throughout my life I have witnessed the prevalence of technology used to drive outrage, encourage isolation, and destroy community. However, I firmly believe there exists another path where data and technology can be used to better humanity and bring us together. 

Using kindness, transparency and dedication I believe we can make this planet a place where everyone can live with dignity, comfort and joy.
